verdict.rationale: HeyGen's developer docs state that its Batch APIs include webhooks. That is a first-party claim of outbound callbacks for API jobs, but it is a single thin mention with no detail on registration, events, or payloads. Missing for 10: documented webhook registration and event types (render completed/failed), payload schema, a documented pollable job-status endpoint, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, my system learns a render finished or failed through a webhook or a documented pollable job status

citations.quote: Batch APIs — up to 100 requests per call, webhooks included
